title: Self-learning git substrate is workspace-bound, can't self-host on orchestrator source
summary: Dogfood finding: lib/git.js scopes every git op to the daemon's workspace path (git -C <ws>). The active workspace (/Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude) is not a git repo and is NOT where the orchestrator code lives — the source is a separate repo at ~/.claude/orchestrator. Therefore the built-in branch_task/merge_attempt MCP tools cannot isolate or merge attempts on the orchestrator's OWN code; they would operate on the workspace dir, not the source repo. To dogfood the self-learning loop on the orchestrator's own code, attempts must use worktrees off ~/.claude/orchestrator manually (bypassing the daemon git tools), OR the daemon needs a way to target a code repo distinct from the workspace. Surfaced 2026-06-07 during first live dogfood of the loop on the token-cost task.
